_doc: Abyssfire VFX recipes, art pass (Art/blender/vfx/fx_recipes.py). Schema: Source/Abyssfire/Public/World/WorldContract.md 5 / AbyssVfxRecipe.h; merged over the runtime's built-in defaults (same id replaces). Textures T_FX_<sprite> are linear RGBA (sRGB off): RGB tints, A coverage; the Flame, ShardFrost, Arrow, Coin, Rock and Chain cells are pre-coloured (white tint). Meshes SM_FX_* are drawn by M_AF_FX_Mesh (one tint per particle, toon bands, ink hull, AF_Data.a value channel).

integration.groundSoftFade: M_AF_FX_Sprite fades every quad with DepthFade(8 cm); ground-oriented quads sit 1-3 cm over the terrain, so decals / rings / shocks / runes draw at 10-30 % strength. Fade ground quads over ~0.8 cm (or skip DepthFade for orient=ground). The previews use 0.8 cm; fx_preview.py --ue-softfade shows the current behaviour.
integration.dirBlowPitch: EAbyssVfxDir::Blow adds Direction.Z = rand(-0.15, 0.35): flight-aligned heads use one particle per projectile (count 1, life = the longest flight) so their pitch is stable; a `flat` option (Z = 0) would let heads respawn every frame and fans fly level.
integration.meshMaterial: mesh layers always draw M_AF_FX_Mesh (opaque masked toon + ink, Bayer fade) — glow, smoke and energy stay sprites; ribbons / crystals / plates / debris / heads are meshes.
integration.bodyOcclusion: Sprites are depth-tested against the opaque characters, and a chest / head anchor is the fx_chest / fx_head socket = the middle of the body, so a burst centred there loses everything inside the silhouette (the web drew FX over its sprites). The strike recipes pull their target-side burst layers 22 cm back along the blow (onto the struck surface, fx_recipes.STRIKE_CM); a burst struck from behind the target (attacker farther from the camera) is still partly hidden. Recommended runtime fix: billboard / velocity layers anchored on an actor (origin / target / point at chest, head, hand or overhead) move their quad toward the camera by min(40 cm, 0.5 x the actor's capsule radius + 20 cm) (Position -= CameraForward * Bias in UAbyssVfxSystem::Tick, or a camera-ward WPO in M_AF_FX_Additive / _Translucent) - at the W1 distance that is <2 % size change.
integration.cameraBias: Blow-less recipes (level-up, pickups, statuses, loot, portal, resonance, props, camps) carry offsetCm d*(-0.455, -0.455, +0.766) with d = 40 cm on their body-anchored quads: with the zero blow the frame is world +X/+Y and the W1 yaw is fixed, so that is the view ray toward the camera (same screen position, drawn over the body). Re-derive (fx_recipes.CAM_BIAS_CM) if the camera yaw ever changes or these events get a blow.
integration.loopPrewarm: Rate emitters start empty (first particle after 1000 / rate ms). Loop layers slower than 3 /s carry a one-particle burst copy (count 1) so a status / prop loop shows at once (fx_recipes.prewarm).
integration.perClassBasic: hit.basic.<class> and hit.impact.<profile> are authored for a one-line runtime change (PlayFirst({hit.basic.<class>, hit.basic}) / ({hit.impact.<profile>, hit.impact})).
integration.elite: elite.<affix> and camp.hearthstone are forward-compatible ids (not bound to events yet).
integration.impactShake: meteor / fireball shakes belong to the impact (combat-feel 11.5); recipe shakes start with the recipe, so the impact recipes (proj.fireball.hit) carry them.
